tools.name: list_sites
tools.title: List the sites
tools.description: List the sites the current user can view, each with its site_id, type, name, label, description and whether it is displayed in the sites menu. Without a keyword: the portal sites. With a keyword: the portal sites whose name or label contains it, and the group sites whose own name contains it; a space's site is named after the group the space was created with (/spaces/<name at creation>), which a later rename of the space does not change, so a renamed space is found by its original name, not by its label (at most 50 group sites are looked up). Use the site_id in get_site and list_site_pages.

keyword.description: A text the portal site's name or label, or the group site's name (for a space, the name it was created with), must contain; it is what lists a space's site. Omit for the portal sites alone

tools.name: get_site
tools.title: Get a site and its layout
tools.description: Read a site's properties (label, description, banner, access and edit permissions) and its layout: left_sidebar, right_sidebar, topbars and bottom_bars, each with its container_id, options (height or width, sticky, display), styling and the applications it holds with their application_id. Returns the user's site draft when they have one (draft: true), the published layout otherwise.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.title: List the pages of a site
tools.description: List the navigation items of a site as a tree. Each item carries its node_id, name and labels per language, url_name, type (page, link or group), page_ref, icon, visibility and schedule, the page's access_permissions and edit_permission, and its children. Draft items are never listed; hidden items are listed only when include_hidden is true and the user can edit the site's navigation. Use the page_ref in get_page_layout.

include_hidden.description: Also list the hidden items; omit to list the visible ones only

tools.name: get_page_layout
tools.title: Get the layout of a page
tools.description: Read the whole page in the shape set_page_layout takes: its ordered sections, each with its section_id and type (dynamic: columns and columns_content, one ordered list of applications per column; grid: rows, columns and cells with their cell_id, row, column, spans and application), the styling and display of sections and applications, and every application's application_id, content_id, instance_id and title. Returns the user's draft by default when they have one, the published layout otherwise; version selects one explicitly.

page_ref.description: The page reference, from list_site_pages (for example portal::mysite::home)

version.description: draft reads the user's draft and fails when they have none; published reads the live layout; omit to read the draft when it exists, the published layout otherwise

tools.name: list_layout_applications
tools.title: List the applications that can be placed
tools.description: List the applications the current user can place on a page or in a site container, each with its instance_id, content_id, name, description, category and whether it is configurable through configure_layout_applications. category_id narrows the list to one category, keyword to the names and descriptions containing it.

category_id.description: A category identifier; omit for every category

keyword.description: A text the name or description must contain; omit for no filter

tools.name: create_site
tools.title: Create a site
tools.description: Create a portal site from a site template, as the sites administration does, for every user at once (not a draft). name is the site's identifier and URL segment (letters, digits, - and _; at most 200 characters) and can never change; label is the name users see, in the platform's default language. Options omitted take the administration's defaults: the basic template, not displayed in the sites menu, the fa-globe icon, and administrators as the only ones who can access and edit the site. Every value is checked before anything is written, and a refused one is answered naming the option. The banner takes a banner_upload_id obtained from upload_layout_image. Returns the site as stored after the creation, its site_id included, whatever the permissions written let the caller read afterwards.

name.description: The site identifier: letters, digits, - and _ only, unique among the portal sites, immutable

label.description: The name shown to users, at most 200 characters

description.description: The site description, at most 2000 characters; omit for none

template.description: The layout name of the site template to create the site from, one of the enabled site templates: basic (default), public, spacePublic, or a template an administrator added

banner_upload_id.description: The upload_id of the banner image, from upload_layout_image; omit for no banner

access_permissions.description: Who can access the site, one or more permissions; omit for administrators only. A permission as the sites administration writes it: Everyone, or <membership>:<group> with an existing membership type (* for any) and an existing group, for example *:/platform/users, *:/platform/administrators, member:/spaces/marketing

edit_permission.description: Who can edit the site, one permission; omit for administrators only. A permission as the sites administration writes it, <membership>:<group> with an existing membership type (* for any) and an existing group, for example *:/platform/users, *:/platform/administrators, member:/spaces/marketing

displayed.description: Show the site in the sites menu; omit for not displayed

icon.description: The icon shown in the sites menu, a Font Awesome class name such as fa-globe; omit for fa-globe

tools.name: update_site
tools.title: Update a site
tools.description: Update a site's label, description, icon, display in the sites menu, banner and permissions, as the sites administration does, for every user at once (not a draft). Only a site the sites administration lists can be updated: a portal site that is not a space's public site; a space's site, a user's site or a template is refused. Every option omitted keeps its stored value; a site's name identifies it and cannot change: change the label instead. label and description are written in the platform's default language; translations in other languages are kept. Permissions are written first, then the properties; when the properties fail, the stored permissions are put back. The banner takes a banner_upload_id from upload_layout_image, or remove_banner true to drop the stored one (not both). A refused value is answered naming the option and nothing is changed; when a later step fails, what was written before it is put back. Returns the site as stored after the change, whatever the permissions written let the caller read afterwards.

label.description: The name shown to users, at most 200 characters; omit to keep it

description.description: The site description, at most 2000 characters, an empty string to clear it; omit to keep it

access_permissions.description: Who can access the site, one or more permissions replacing the stored ones; omit to keep them. A permission as the sites administration writes it: Everyone, or <membership>:<group> with an existing membership type (* for any) and an existing group, for example *:/platform/users, *:/platform/administrators, member:/spaces/marketing

edit_permission.description: Who can edit the site, one permission; omit to keep it. A permission as the sites administration writes it, <membership>:<group> with an existing membership type (* for any) and an existing group, for example *:/platform/users, *:/platform/administrators, member:/spaces/marketing

displayed.description: Show the site in the sites menu; omit to keep it; false is refused on the platform's main site, which is always shown

icon.description: The icon shown in the sites menu, a Font Awesome class name such as fa-globe; omit to keep it

banner_upload_id.description: The upload_id of the new banner image, from upload_layout_image; omit to keep the banner

remove_banner.description: true removes the stored banner; omit to keep it

tools.name: delete_site
tools.title: Delete a site
tools.description: Delete a site with its pages and navigation, for every user at once and without undo, as the sites administration does: in the platform's assistant the user confirms it before it applies; an external client asks for confirmation only if its own settings do. A site the administration never offers to delete is refused: one the platform ships as not removable, a space's site or public site, a user's site, a template.

tools.name: update_theme
tools.title: Update a part of the theme
tools.description: Update one part of the platform theme, as the corresponding drawer of the Branding and Theme administration does, for every user at once (not a draft): in the platform's assistant the user confirms it before it applies; an external client asks for confirmation only if its own settings do. options sets the named options to the given values (strings, as the drawer sends them: colours as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, sizes with their unit such as 16px, keywords such as normal or bold); reset returns the named options to their configured default; every other option keeps its stored value. Options per part. colors: primaryColor, secondaryColor, tertiaryColor. font: fontFamily, one of the platform's supported families. topbar: topBarBackgroundColor, topBarBackgroundPosition, topBarBackgroundSize, topBarBackgroundRepeat, topBarTextColor, topBarTextFontSize, topBarTextFontStyle, topBarTextFontWeight, topBarIconColor, topBarSticky (true or false), topBarBackgroundScrollColor (the colour once scrolled, when sticky). sidebars: sideBarBackgroundColor, sideBarBackgroundImage, sideBarBackgroundPosition, sideBarBackgroundSize, sideBarBackgroundRepeat, sideBarTextColor, sideBarTextFontSize, sideBarTextFontStyle, sideBarTextFontWeight, sideBarTextSubtitleColor, sideBarTextSubtitleFontSize, sideBarTextSubtitleFontStyle, sideBarTextSubtitleFontWeight, sideBarIconColor. drawers: drawerBackgroundColor, drawerBackgroundImage, drawerBackgroundPosition, drawerBackgroundSize, drawerBackgroundRepeat, drawerIconColor, then Color, FontSize, FontStyle and FontWeight for each of drawerText, drawerTextSubtitle, drawerTextTitle and drawerTextHeader (for example drawerTextTitleColor). Every option ending in BackgroundImage takes none or exactly one CSS gradient function, such as linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff, #000000): the image file itself is uploaded in the drawer, and a url() or a second layer is refused. page_and_apps: pageWidth (100px to 3000px, or 100%), pageBackgroundColor (a hex colour), pageBackgroundEffect (one CSS gradient function, or none), pageBackgroundSize, pageBackgroundRepeat, pageBackgroundPosition, pageBackgroundAttachment (CSS keywords), pageMarginTop, pageMarginRight, pageMarginBottom, pageMarginLeft, appMarginTop, appMarginRight, appMarginBottom, appMarginLeft, appBorderColor, appBorderSize, appBoxShadow, borderRadius, appBorderRadiusTopLeft, appBorderRadiusTopRight, appBorderRadiusBottomLeft, appBorderRadiusBottomRight, appBackgroundColor, appBackgroundImage, appBackgroundPosition, appBackgroundSize, appBackgroundRepeat, appIconColor, then Color, FontSize, FontStyle and FontWeight for each of appText, appTextTitle, appTextHeader and appTextSubtitle, and Color, Image, Position, Size, Repeat, PaddingTop, PaddingRight, PaddingBottom, PaddingLeft and Radius for each of appTextTitleBackground and appTextHeaderBackground. Images (logo, favicon, background files) are not theme options. A value the platform refuses is answered with its reason and nothing is changed. Returns the part's options as stored.

part.description: The part of the theme to update

options.description: The options of the part to set, by name, with their values as strings; omit an option to leave it unchanged

reset.description: The options of the part to return to their configured default; omit for none; an option cannot be both set and reset

tools.name: update_navigation_display
tools.title: Update what the topbar and the sidebar show
tools.description: Update what the topbar shows and how the sidebar may be displayed, as the navigation settings page does, for every user at once (not a draft): in the platform's assistant the user confirms it before it applies; an external client asks for confirmation only if its own settings do. Every field omitted keeps its stored value. topbar: display_company_name, display_site_name, display_mobile_company_logo, and applications, a list of {id or name, enabled, mobile} merged into the topbar's applications: an entry names its application by id (as this tool returns it) or, without an id, by its name as shown in the topbar settings in the user's language (case-insensitive, refused when two applications share it); an application not in the topbar is refused; mobile also shows the application on mobile; the order of the applications is not changed by this tool. sidebar: allow_user_custom_home, allowed_modes (replaces the list; hidden, icon or sticky, at least one), default_mode (one of the allowed modes). The sidebar's items are not changed by this tool. Returns both parts as stored, each topbar application with its id and its name in the user's language.

topbar.description: What the topbar shows; omit to leave the topbar unchanged

display_company_name.description: Show the company name next to the logo as the platform's identity: on wide screens when the sidebar is hidden or reduced to icons, or when no site name or logo is shown; on medium screens only when no site name or logo is shown

display_mobile_company_logo.description: Show the company logo on mobile

applications.description: The topbar applications to change, each named by id or by name; omit to leave them all

id.description: The application identifier, as returned by this tool; omit to name the application by its name

name.description: The application name as shown in the topbar settings in the user's language, used when no id is given

enabled.description: Show the application in the topbar

sidebar.description: How the sidebar may be displayed; omit to leave the sidebar unchanged

allow_user_custom_home.description: Let each user choose their own home page

allowed_modes.description: The modes users may choose from, replacing the stored list; at least one

default_mode.description: The mode a user gets before choosing one; must be an allowed mode
